evals.prompt: I need to backup my entire Claude setup including all skills, agents, and plugins before I wipe my machine. Can you help me package everything into a zip file?
evals.expected_output: A ZIP file containing skills, agents, and plugins, with the packaging script used to create the package. Should include a manifest.json showing what was packaged.

assertions.name: creates_zip_package
assertions.description: Creates a ZIP file containing the packaged configs

assertions.name: includes_plugins
assertions.description: Package includes all installed plugins from cache and marketplaces

assertions.name: includes_manifest
assertions.description: Package contains a manifest.json listing contents

assertions.name: provides_deploy_instructions
assertions.description: Explains how to deploy the package on another machine

assertions.name: warns_about_sensitive_data
assertions.description: Mentions that settings may contain API tokens or sensitive data

evals.prompt: I have a claude-config-20260308.zip file in my Downloads folder that my teammate sent me. I want to install their skills and agents but keep my existing plugins. How do I do this?
evals.expected_output: Instructions to deploy the package using merge mode, preserving existing plugins while adding new skills and agents. Should run the deploy command with --target ~/.claude --mode merge.

assertions.name: uses_merge_mode
assertions.description: Recommends using merge mode to preserve existing plugins

assertions.name: provides_deploy_command
assertions.description: Provides the correct deploy command with proper flags

assertions.name: explains_merge_behavior
assertions.description: Explains that merge mode keeps existing files and adds new ones

assertions.name: mentions_bundle_deploy_script
assertions.description: Mentions the DEPLOY.py script bundled inside the ZIP

evals.prompt: I created some custom skills that I want to share with my team. How can I package just the skills without my plugins or settings?
evals.expected_output: A ZIP file containing only skills (no plugins, settings, or agents). The packaging script should be instructed to only include skills directory.

assertions.name: uses_skills_flag_only
assertions.description: Uses --skills flag without --plugins or --settings

assertions.name: excludes_settings
assertions.description: Does not include settings.json in package

assertions.name: excludes_plugins
assertions.description: Does not include plugin files in package

assertions.name: mentions_safe_for_sharing
assertions.description: Notes that skills-only package is safe to share (no API tokens)

evals.prompt: I downloaded a claude package but I only want to install the agents, not the skills or plugins. Can I choose what to install?
evals.expected_output: Use interactive mode (--interactive flag) to let the user select which components to deploy. Should explain the interactive selection process.

assertions.name: mentions_interactive_mode
assertions.description: Explains the --interactive flag for selective deployment

assertions.name: shows_selection_menu
assertions.description: Shows the interactive selection menu options

assertions.name: correct_input_for_agents_only
assertions.description: Indicates that 'a' should be entered to select only agents

assertions.name: provides_deploy_command
assertions.description: Provides the full command with --interactive flag

evals.prompt: Create a complete backup of my Claude configuration that I can use to restore on a fresh machine. Include everything - skills, agents, plugins, settings, and any project configs.
evals.expected_output: A comprehensive ZIP package with all components: skills, agents, plugins, settings.json, project CLAUDE.md files, and custom scripts. Deploy script bundled for easy restoration.

assertions.name: includes_all_components
assertions.description: Package includes skills, agents, plugins, settings, and project configs

assertions.name: bundles_deploy_script
assertions.description: Package includes DEPLOY.py for easy restoration

assertions.name: provides_restore_instructions
assertions.description: Explains how to restore the backup on a new machine

assertions.name: warns_about_sensitive_data
assertions.description: Warns user about API tokens or other sensitive data in settings.json

evals.prompt: My Claude configs are stored in /opt/claude/config instead of the default location. How do I backup my skills?
evals.expected_output: Use the --config flag to specify the custom config directory path when running the packaging script.

assertions.name: uses_config_flag
assertions.description: Uses --config flag to specify custom directory

assertions.name: provides_correct_path
assertions.description: Uses the user-specified path /opt/claude/config

assertions.name: mentions_env_var_alternative
assertions.description: Mentions CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR environment variable as alternative
